# Hello World Application

## Requirements

- The application must start successfully.
- When started, the application must display `Hello, World!`.
- Must also output date and time in UTC

claims.text: When started, the application must display the specified greeting.
The application must also output date and time in UTC.

fixture.description: MOCK Controlled seed used only for offline context construction.

seed.title: MOCK Startup display
seed.description: MOCK On startup the application starts successfully, displays the supplied greeting and outputs UTC date and time.
seed.primary_goal: MOCK Present the greeting and UTC time on successful startup.
seed.story: MOCK As a user, I start the application so that it starts successfully, displays the supplied greeting and outputs UTC date and time.
seed.entity_basis: MOCK Startup, greeting display and UTC time output need no business entity records.
seed.given: MOCK The application is ready to start.
seed.when: MOCK The user starts the application.
seed.then: MOCK Startup succeeds and the supplied greeting and UTC date and time are displayed.
seed.functional_requirement: MOCK On startup the application must start successfully, display the supplied greeting and output UTC date and time.

obligations: date and time output in UTC

record_seeds.given: MOCK The application is ready to start.
record_seeds.when: MOCK The user starts the application.
record_seeds.then: MOCK Startup succeeds and the supplied greeting and UTC date and time are displayed.
record_seeds.functional_requirement: MOCK On startup the application must start successfully, display the supplied greeting and output UTC date and time.

MOCK An equipment register must retain equipment identifiers and inspection results.
MOCK When an inspection fails, the register must mark that equipment unavailable until a later successful inspection.

claims.text: MOCK An equipment register must retain equipment identifiers and inspection results.
MOCK When an inspection fails, the register must mark that equipment unavailable until a later successful inspection.

fixture.description: MOCK Controlled seed used only for offline context construction.

seed.title: MOCK Equipment inspections
seed.description: MOCK The register retains equipment identifiers and inspection results; failed inspections keep equipment unavailable until a later successful inspection.
seed.primary_goal: MOCK Record inspections and prevent availability after a failed inspection until a successful inspection.
seed.story: MOCK As an operator, I record inspections so that equipment with failed inspections remains unavailable until a later successful inspection.
seed.entity_basis: MOCK Equipment and inspection results are business data whose association and availability are required.
seed.given: MOCK An equipment item is recorded in the register.
seed.when: MOCK An inspection result is recorded.
seed.then: MOCK The equipment identifier and inspection result are retained.
seed.functional_requirement: MOCK The register must retain equipment identifiers and inspection results.

obligations: retain equipment identifiers and inspection results
remain unavailable until later successful inspection
forbidden: availability after failure without successful inspection

record_seeds.given: MOCK An equipment item is recorded in the register.
record_seeds.when: MOCK An inspection result is recorded.
record_seeds.then: MOCK The equipment identifier and inspection result are retained.
record_seeds.functional_requirement: MOCK The register must retain equipment identifiers and inspection results.

record_seeds.given: MOCK Equipment has failed an inspection.
record_seeds.when: MOCK Its availability is checked before a later successful inspection.
record_seeds.functional_requirement: MOCK When an inspection fails, that equipment must remain unavailable until a later successful inspection.

MOCK A library must track loans and their return deadlines.
MOCK Eligible renewals extend the return deadline; the extension duration is undecided.

claims.text: MOCK The library must track loans and return deadlines.
MOCK Eligible renewals extend the return deadline, but the extension duration is undecided.

fixture.description: MOCK Controlled seed used only for offline context construction.

seed.title: MOCK Loan renewal
seed.description: MOCK The library tracks loans and return deadlines; eligible renewal extends the deadline but the extension duration remains undecided.
seed.primary_goal: MOCK Track loans and renew eligible deadlines once the extension duration is specified.
seed.story: MOCK As a borrower, I renew an eligible loan so that its return deadline is extended; the extension duration requires a decision.
seed.entity_basis: MOCK Loans and their return deadlines are business data used by eligible renewals.
seed.given: MOCK The loan is eligible for renewal.
seed.then: MOCK The return deadline is extended by the duration that remains to be specified.
seed.functional_requirement: MOCK The library must track loans and return deadlines and extend eligible renewal deadlines by the still-undecided duration.

forbidden: turn supplied eligibility into a new missing user decision

record_seeds.given: MOCK The loan is eligible for renewal.
record_seeds.then: MOCK The return deadline is extended by the duration that remains to be specified.
record_seeds.functional_requirement: MOCK The library must track loans and return deadlines and extend eligible renewal deadlines by the still-undecided duration.
